remarks: Charming & Spacious Norwalk Home - Perfect for First-Time Buyers! or just to upgrade your living spacel  Welcome to this beautifully maintained and surprisingly spacious home located in a desirable Norwalk neighborhood - close to highways, shopping, dining, and offering an easy commute to NYC.  Ideal for first-time homebuyers, this home offers 3 bedrooms with the flexibility for a possible 4th, giving you room to grow without outgrowing your home too quickly. The large basement offers incredible potential for future expansion - a playroom, home office, gym, or additional living space as your needs evolve. and don't forget the additional easy access garage.  Major updates are already done, providing peace of mind for new homeowners, including a brand-new roof and new heating system. Hardwood floors throughout add warmth, character, and timeless appeal. Also a beautiful fireplace, for warm cozy nights in the winterl  The layout is generous with multiple living areas, making the home feel much larger than expected - you may actually get lost in the space! Outside, enjoy a private backyard with your own deck, perfect for entertaining or quiet evenings at home. The corner lot provides extra privacy and ample side-street parking, a rare find  With Norwalk's beaches, parks, restaurants, shopping, and commuter access, this home offers an incredible opportunity to start your homeownership journey in a town that has so much to offer. Move in now, grow over time,Don't wait!
